role: limited retrospective, outcome-blind user-held-out RM ablation; not independent test

models.strict_additive_linear: separate context and item terms without history-item interactions
models.refit_residual_support_optimized_control: panel_tools.1 optimized-HGB feature/parameter architecture refit on the same training users
models.prefix_safe_affinity_extension: same optimized-HGB architecture and data with exactly nine prefix-derived history-item affinity/missingness columns

forbidden_target_features: events at or after earliest target timestamp
primary_comparison: prefix_safe_affinity_extension versus refit_residual_support_optimized_control on the same held-out users, paired user bootstrap
interpretation_limit: logged-ratio prediction improvement does not establish counterfactual ranking quality or policy/relevance improvement
